You are fixing marketing COPY in the Nxeon repo worktree at /opt/nxeon-wt-pricing (Next.js 15 App Router + Tailwind). Edit ONLY this one file: app/(marketing)/vps/page.tsx. Do NOT touch any other file. Do NOT run any build, `next build`, `prisma generate`, or `prisma db push` — editing only.

SHARED PROMO FACTS (single source of truth):
- ONE promotion site-wide: **First month free** (first month $0, then regular price forever; capped 1/account + 1/IP). NOT a "% off first term", NOT annual.
- Billing is **monthly, prepaid from a wallet**. NO annual billing, NO multi-year/3-year term exists. Remove any such claim.
- "The price you sign up at is the price you renew at" is now TRUE — don't contradict it.
- Real VPS prices (monthly): Nano $6.49, Starter $8.99, Standard $12.99, Pro $20.99, Max $32.99.

YOUR TASK in app/(marketing)/vps/page.tsx:
1. Find and REMOVE the false band claiming "Save up to 20% on 3-year terms with annual billing" (audit cites ~line 226). The hero/FAQ on this same page say billing is monthly — this contradicts them.
2. Remove/correct any other annual/3-year/multi-year language to monthly.
3. If the page renders a shared <PricingGrid> promo component, LEAVE that component file alone (another agent owns it) — only fix inline copy in THIS page.
4. Do NOT redesign; consistency/copy fix only. Keep all real prices/specs.
5. Keep JSX valid; remove any import left unused by your deletion.

Read the file first, edit surgically, then report: exact before→after of each change, and confirm no annual/3-year claim remains. Final message is a report to the orchestrator — concise and factual.
